title: ZXTank Game Modes
seoTitle: ZXTank Game Modes | Solo, DeathMatch & Team Battle | BarkinMad Studios
description: Explore the game modes available in ZXTank, including Solo, DeathMatch and Team Battle across procedurally generated battlefields.
summary: Choose how you want to fight, whether you're taking on AI opponents alone or battling other commanders in multiplayer.
heroImageAlt: Illustration representing the different game modes available in ZXTank

sections.heading: Battle Your Way
paragraphs: ZXTank offers multiple ways to play, from challenging AI battles to competitive multiplayer matches. Every battle takes place on a procedurally generated battlefield, ensuring no two matches feel exactly the same.
Master your tank, manage battlefield damage, recover valuable salvage and use the terrain to outmanoeuvre your opponents.

sections.heading: Solo
paragraphs: Fight against three AI-controlled tanks in a tactical battle where positioning, repairs and battlefield awareness are just as important as accurate shooting.
AI commanders make use of the battlefield, collect salvage, compete for upgrades and take advantage of terrain to keep every battle unpredictable.

sections.heading: DeathMatch
paragraphs: Every tank fights for itself in a classic free-for-all battle. Depending on the number of players, AI tanks can fill supported empty positions to keep matches competitive.
Control key areas, collect upgrades, repair damaged systems and be the last commander standing.

sections.heading: Team Battle
paragraphs: Work together in teams of two to outplay the opposition. Coordinate attacks, support damaged teammates and compete for strategic locations across the battlefield.
Sharing information, controlling objectives and protecting your team's resources can make the difference between victory and defeat.

sections.heading: Every Battle Is Different
paragraphs: Battlefields are procedurally generated using carefully balanced layouts that combine open fields, woodland, villages, ruins, roads, rivers and bridges.
Strategic locations such as Repair Depots, Radar Stations and Supply Depots encourage players to fight over valuable areas while adapting to changing terrain and opportunities.
